description: Find indexed House Hansard speeches by speaker, bill debated or mentioned, or date. contains scans at most 100 candidate speeches per call; follow nextOffset without changing filters until exhausted before drawing a negative conclusion.

billDebated.description: Bill debated; combined with all other scopes using AND.

code.description: Required bill code, including a split-bill suffix letter such as C-15A; accepts bill s321, S321, S 321, or S-321.

session.description: Required explicit parliament-session for this bill.

contains.description: Local case-insensitive Unicode-normalized literal English text substring; cannot be the only scope.

dateFrom.description: Inclusive Ottawa civil date lower bound, YYYY-MM-DD; independently optional.

dateTo.description: Inclusive Ottawa civil date upper bound, YYYY-MM-DD; independently optional.

limit.description: Maximum returned matches, 1–10 per call; larger values up to 10000 clamp to 10 with a notice. A page ends early at the 24000-byte response budget, returning at least one match whole. Candidate pages contain 20 rows.

mentionedBill.description: Bill mentioned; combined with all other scopes using AND.

code.description: Required bill code, including a split-bill suffix letter such as C-15A; accepts bill s321, S321, S 321, or S-321.

session.description: Required explicit parliament-session for this bill.

offset.description: Raw candidate offset; keep every filter identical when continuing.

politician.description: Speaker OpenParliament slug or exact politician path/HTTPS URL (member.slug from canparl_get_member, or an includeFormer canparl_search_members row), or a current MP's official personId. A digit-only value equal to a current personId, or its /politicians/<digits>/ path or profile URL, is read as that personId.

substantiveOnly.description: Exclude procedural remarks when true; false includes substantive and procedural remarks.

name: canparl_search_speeches

appliedFilters.description: All normalized filters applied with AND; bill relationships rely on the source endpoint.

contains.description: Trimmed local literal English text filter, or null.

dateFrom.description: Inclusive normalized lower date, or null.

dateTo.description: Inclusive normalized upper date, or null.

politician.description: Normalized verified speaker slug, or null.

politicianName.description: Name on the verified OpenParliament speaker profile, or null.

cap.description: Effective maximum returned matches after the per-call cap.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `speech_scope_required`: No speaker, bill, or date bound is supplied. `invalid_speech_filter`: A slug, bill, or date is malformed, incomplete, or has reversed bounds. `speech_entity_not_found`: A supplied speaker or bill is absent from OpenParliament, or a current personId has no unique verified profile. `upstream_filter_not_honored`: A returned candidate violates an applied speaker, time, or procedural filter. `upstream_blocked`: An official parliamentary source refuses the request with HTTP 403. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

excludedCommittees.description: Visited candidates excluded because they were not House debate documents.

exhausted.description: True only after visiting every row of a source-terminal page.

nextOffset.description: First unvisited raw candidate offset, or null when exhausted; after a response-budget stop, the first match not returned.

notice.description: Limit clamp, coverage, continuation, procedural-filter, unavailable affiliation, and response-budget guidance.

provenance.description: Original retrieval metadata for scope validation, candidate pages fetched before the page ended, and memberships of returned speeches.

cached.description: Whether this response came from the in-memory cache.

scanned.description: Raw candidates visited, including excluded committee records; at most 100. A response-budget stop ends it before the first match not returned.

speeches.description: Matching House speeches in source order with complete English prose.

items.description: One indexed House speech with complete text and historical affiliation.

content.description: Complete English plain text, or null when unavailable.

debateUrl.description: Absolute HTTPS House debate document link.

membershipUrl.description: Historical membership HTTPS URL, or null.

party.description: Party from the speech-date membership, or null when unavailable.

politician.description: OpenParliament speaker slug, or null for institutional speakers.

procedural.description: Source procedural flag, or null when unavailable.

riding.description: Riding from the speech-date membership, or null when unavailable.

time.description: Original Ottawa civil date-time; no timezone offset is invented.

truncated.description: Whether raw candidates remain to be scanned; not an exact count of further matches.

title: Canparl Search Speeches
